english.title: Make a false statement in an application for a special procedure licence or approval (Wales)
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) made a statement that was false or misleading, knowing or being reckless as to whether it was false or misleading in an application for the

(A)_[issue of a special procedure licence in accordance with Schedule 3 to]_
(B)_[variation of a special procedure licence in accordance with Schedule 3 to]_
(C)_[renewal of a special procedure licence in accordance with Schedule 3 to]_
(D)_[approval of premises under section 70 of]_
(E)_[approval of a vehicle under section 70 of]_

the Public Health (Wales) Act 2017
english.legislation: Contrary to section 82(7) and (9) of the Public Health (Wales) Act 2017.
english.pointstoprove: date and location in Walesapplied for the issue OR variation OR renewal of a special procedure licence or approval of premises/vehicle and made a statement that was false or misleadingknowing or being reckless as to whether it was false or misleading
